title: Zelenskyy heads to Florida for talks with Trump amid fresh strikes on Kyiv
summary: Attacks leave hundreds of thousands without heating as Ukrainian leader readies for intense weekend of diplomacy A third of Kyiv is without heating after a Russian drone and missile barrage on the Ukrainian capital cut off power supplies, leaving hundreds of thousands of people facing freezing temperatures. Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said Moscow had used nearly 500 drones and 40 missiles, including ballistic missiles, in the overnight attack. “The primary target is Kyiv – energy facilities and civilian infrastructure,” he said in a post on X.
